purpose: Standalone review-only morning-room prototype. Existing calico assets copied byte-for-byte; no image generation, recoloring, mirroring, repacking or resampling.
author: Existing Wanpet project asset authors; this prototype only copies files and renders source frames.
license: No new license asserted. Existing repository assets; rights review remains pending per assets/manifest.json.
provenanceNotes: Rest source: active apps/godot/data/engawa-pet.json and apps/godot/scripts/engawa_home.gd.
Walk source: active apps/godot/data/pet.json and apps/godot/scripts/pet.gd.

Walk atlases are already resampled runtime assets from the repository. Their previous optimization and original video identity limits are recorded in assets/video/runtime-packing-v1/README.md and assets/video/four-direction-v1/README.md. This prototype makes no new image changes.
This preview is not a native Godot animation or device-performance verification.

rest.sampling: No skipped frames within the included range. Rest is limited to the first atlas.
rest.loopNote: The first 18 frames repeat every 0.75 s; this is a bounded review clip, not the full 121-frame native rest animation.

left.sampling: All source frames included; no temporal sampling.
